name: The Ridge Shrine
sublabel: Atop the mountain, apart from the University's own peak
flavor: Small, weatherworn, deliberately unclaimed by any current religious or campus group.

beats.title: Practical Offerings
beats.body: Whatever's left here is never decorative — a coil of rope, a sealed jar, a pair of gloves. Never flowers, never trinkets. Someone's need, not a tribute.

beats.title: The Scratched Name
beats.body: A name carved into the base has been scratched out — the same rough, deliberate gouge as the wall at the Ruins. Whether it's the same name is impossible to tell.

beats.title: Facing the Wrong Way
beats.body: The shrine faces inland, directly toward the Ruins, not out toward the sea the way every other shrine on this kind of island usually does.

beats.title: Fresh Flowers
beats.body: For the first time on record, there are flowers here instead of a practical object — recent, not yet wilted. Nobody on staff will admit to leaving them.

shrineFinale.note: Design placeholder -- Story_Mode.md §4.8 specifies three 500+ word metaphorical carvings (Ada Lovelace / Charles Babbage / Alan Turing) plus a 3-way ending choice with the Woman in White, unlocked once all seven Field Badges are collected. That vision-text is called out in the doc's own §7 next steps as a later writing pass, so it isn't authored here -- this object is the hook Phase 2 hangs off of.
